MRCN_API_BASE_URL.description: Official CN mini-program API base URL

MRCN_REQUEST_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Default POST JSON template. Use {uid} placeholder.

MRCN_HEADERS_JSON.description: Request headers JSON. Keep temporary credentials local.

MRCN_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Temporary access_token from the mini-program request header
MRCN_ACCESS_TOKEN.hint: 敏感凭据：仅在受控的 AstrBot WebUI 中填写，不要截图、分享或提交 data/config 下的配置文件。Token 过期后需要更新。

MRCN_CA_CERT.description: Optional CA PEM path, for example the mitmproxy CA certificate

MRCN_VERIFY_SSL.description: Keep TLS verification enabled; disable only for local diagnosis

MRCN_PROXY.description: Optional HTTP proxy, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080

MRCN_TRUST_ENV.description: Whether httpx should inherit HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY from the process environment

MRCN_ASSET_CACHE_DIR.description: Optional runtime asset cache directory; empty uses AstrBot plugin_data

MRCN_ASSET_REFRESH_DAYS.description: Revalidation interval for cached remote images

MRCN_ASSET_MAX_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum concurrent asset downloads during warmup

MRCN_ASSET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Timeout for one remote asset download in seconds

MRCN_DEFAULT_SEASON.description: Default season number used when a command does not specify one

MRCN_ROLE_PATH.description: Resolve and validate a public role ID

MRCN_HERO_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Hero request JSON template. Use {hero_ids}, {season} and {player_uid} placeholders.

MRCN_SUMMARY_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Summary request JSON template. Use {season} and {player_uid}.

MRCN_CAREER_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Career request JSON template. Use {season} and {player_uid}.

MRCN_SORT_HERO_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Sorted heroes request JSON template. Use {season} and {player_uid}.

MRCN_SUMMARY_DETAIL_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Match detail request JSON template. Use {match_uids}.

MRCN_MATCHES_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Recent matches request JSON template. Use {season} and {player_uid}.
